title: Judgment
description: spoke-judgment assessment envelope: a declared verdict about a target, backed by evidence that pins exact revisions. Optional data/conformance capability — defines no engine, reasoner, storage behavior, or Connect operation.

judgment_kind.description: Open string. Core vocabulary (documented, not enforced): consistency (assesses consistency), support (assesses evidentiary support), acceptance (assesses acceptance), review (records a review outcome). Products MAY emit namespaced kinds such as my-product:belief-assessment; unknown non-empty values remain valid and need no registry update.

evidence.description: JudgmentRef list backing the judgment; present even when empty. Every item is a JudgmentEvidenceRef — a JudgmentRef narrowed to a required positive revision, so evidence always carries the exact revisions the judgment relies on.

basis.description: Optional product-supplied explanation or rationale; it does not replace evidence.

JudgmentRef.title: JudgmentRef
JudgmentRef.description: Dedicated lightweight reference used by Judgment.target and every Judgment.evidence[] item. Carries only kind, id, optional product scope, and optional revision; it does not reuse CognitionReference or CognitionTarget. On Judgment.target the revision is optional and positive when present.

kind.description: Identifies the referenced thing's kind without a protocol registry; open string.

id.description: Opaque stable id within the applicable kind and product scope.

namespace.description: Optional product scope for the reference. Not a required component of the referenced thing's identity.

revision.description: Pins the referenced revision when revision pinning applies; positive (>= 1) when present.

JudgmentEvidenceRef.title: JudgmentEvidenceRef
JudgmentEvidenceRef.description: JudgmentRef narrowed for Judgment.evidence[] items: revision is required and positive — the exact revision the judgment relies on.

revision.description: Required positive revision — evidence refs always pin the exact revision relied on.

Verdict.title: Verdict
Verdict.description: Closed verdict core plus open product detail.

detail.description: Optional product-specific assessment content, opaque to the envelope validator and included in canonicalization. Direct members MUST NOT duplicate protocol-level envelope locations: the reserved direct member names are target, evidence, judgment_kind, and outcome.
